The instant petition has been filed praying for quashing of the preliminary notification issued under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 proposing to acquire inter-alia the land of the petitioners at Entry No. 41 and 50 in respect of plots no. 151 and 166 village Aakalpur, Tehsil Jewar, District Gautam Buddha Nagar.

sentences.text: Sri Aditya Bhushan Singhal, learned counsel for the respondent-Authority submits that final declaration under Section 19 has yet not been issued.
The petitioners have right to file objections and the same would be decided as per the procedure prescribed under Section 15 of the Act.
3. Counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have already filed objections.

4. Since, final declaration has yet not been issued and the objections of the petitioners are admittedly pending, therefore, no good ground is made out to examine the validity of the preliminary notification at this stage.
5. The petition is disposed of, accordingly with liberty to the petitioners to press their objections which are stated to be pending so that the same are decided as per the procedure prescribed.

Order Date :- 30.5.2024 Mukesh Kr.
(Kshitij Shailendra,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
